headline: Executive order adds more members to the President's Advisory Council on Doing Business in Africa.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13675, which set up an advisory council on doing business in Africa. It increases the number of people who can serve on that council. The council gives advice to the President on business ties between the United States and African countries. No further details were provided in the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Business leaders who could be appointed to the council
who_it_affects.how: More seats on the council means more private-sector leaders may be chosen to advise the President on business with Africa.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 3, 2016; executive orders like this generally take effect when signed.
